Produced by Warrior, this Clear Whey Isolate delivers a lighter fruity twist to the classic protein milkshake of the past. Perfect for when you need a fast protein hit without that bloaty feeling, Warrior Clear Whey Isolate is sippable and drinkable like a normal fruit juice. Using only the purest of whey isolates, servings of 25-grams are 90% protein (22.56-grams to be precise), come virtually sugar-free and are super low in calories, fats and carbs. It's a fruit flavoured protein masterstroke. 375g = 15 servings 25g = 1 serving Ingredients Ingredients: Ultra-Pure WHEY Protein Isolate (MILK), Flavours, Colourings, Sweeteners (Sucralose, Ace-K). matches_set.description: 'Sweet Meets Savory.' Our Salted Caramel Ultra Protein shake is balanced and easy-drinking from first sip to last. With 42g of protein and only 1g of sugar, it's proof that sweet and savory were always meant to be together.

Summary Flavor Profile The perfect balance! Sweet and salty indulges your taste buds in guilt-free pleasure. Quench your dessert craving for fresh baked cookies (or better yet, cookie dough!) by adding oats, frozen banana and dash of cinnamon. Product Facts Type: Powder Serving Size: 1 scoop (29.8g) Servings: 28 Benefits Our expertly formulated organic Meal Replacement Shake provides 15 grams of plant-based protein through our exclusive Tri-Plex Protein Blend (™) including pumpkin , pea and rice protein, coconut creamer and nutritious superfoods. With 5 grams of fiber and zero grams of sugar, you can maintain a healthy lifestyle by doing what’s right for your body. Balanced nutrition and measurable lasting results! Ingredients Triplex Protein Blend (TM) - An easily digestible blend of Pumpkin, rice and pea protein, when paired together deliver a full amino acid profile along with a powerhouse combination of fiber, vitamins and antioxidants. This clean, highly concentrated source of protein helps with satiety due to the content of filling fiber, and also makes it easy for the body to make the most of the nutrients available to help support weight loss. Vietnamese-style Chicken Noodle Soup This popular street food is known the world over for its comforting effects. The steaming, savory, and immensely aromatic broth is the foundation of this restorative dish. Notes of cinnamon and star anise, followed by fresh ginger and clove keep it authentic. Braised chicken thighs, cabbage, scallion, and cilantro provide the additional sustenance needed for any adventure. Braised antibiotic-free dark meat chicken Jalapenos provide cardiovascular and immunity benefits A separate lime packet allows you to season to your liking Fast 10-minute cooking time 4-year shelf life _______________________________________________ Ingredients: Dark meat chicken (chicken raised without antibiotics), rice noodles (rice flour, water), dried cabbage, powdered chicken broth, grapeseed oil, ginger, dried scallion, dried shallots, fish sauce powder (anchovies, salt, maltodextrin), crystallized lime (citric acid, lime oil, lime juice), sea salt, dried cilantro, dried shiitake mushroom powder, dried jalapeno, dried cloves, cinnamon, star anise Contains: Fish Servings per container: 1 Single serving: 390 calories, 8g fat, 1220mg sodium, 54g carb, 2g fiber, 27g protein

Tasteless Protein by Feel Good Protein® is a tasteless protein powder created for those who want a simple, versatile way to include more protein in their day, without changing the taste, smell, or texture of their foods and drinks. Perfect for anyone on their health, wellness and fitness journey! Made from high-quality hydrolysed collagen, Tasteless Protein dissolves easily and mixes without graininess. Its fine texture and neutral flavour make it an effortless addition to coffee, smoothies, yoghurt, soups and everyday meals. Each serve provides 14.2 g of protein and delivers all 9 essential amino acids, which is commonly missing from other collagen supplements. With no fats, sugars, carbohydrates, gluten or dairy, Tasteless Protein is a popular choice for people who prefer a lighter, more flexible protein option that fits easily into a wide range of routines and lifestyles.
